gramlot-js-server 0.2.8 follows the core 0.2.14: every call of a page is one envelope on `POST /gramlot/rpc`, answered by `GramlotServer.call`, and the Worker of the serverless package speaks the same envelope over `postMessage` (GC-230 Part C). The three packages require `@gramlot/gramlot` 0.2.14 or later.

## Changes

- `@gramlot/gramlot-js-server`
  - `POST /gramlot/rpc` passes the body, the request envelope `{id, pageId, contentType, name, params}`, to `GramlotServer.call` with the owner of `ownerForRequest` and answers 200 `application/json` with the response envelope; `InvalidRequest` answers 400 `Invalid envelope`. Outcomes (`page_expired`, `not_found`, `not_authenticated`, `not_authorized`, `application_error`) travel in the envelope with status 200: an expired page or an unknown Source method no longer answers 404.
  - The routes `/gramlot/main` and `/gramlot/source` and the options `mainUrl` and `sourceUrl` are gone; `rpcUrl` (default `/gramlot/rpc`) and `closeUrl` remain. The bootstrap config is `{pageId, rpcUrl, closeUrl, rootId, capabilities}`.
  - The adapter sets no body size limit: the 4096-byte read and its 413 are removed. A proxy in front may set a limit.
  - `POST /gramlot/close` with `{pageId}` is unchanged.
- `@gramlot/gramlot-serverless`
  - `GramlotWorkerServer` answers `{id, open: true}` with `{id, open: {pageId, title, resources, capabilities: []}}`, `{id, text}` with `{id, text}` (the response envelope of `call`), and closes the page on `{pageId}` without `id`. A failed open, `InvalidRequest` and an unknown message answer `{id, error: {name, message}}`. The operations `open`, `main` and `source` are gone.
  - `WorkerTransport` exposes `open(signal)`, `call(text, signal)` like the core `HttpTransport`, `close(pageId)` and `dispose(error)`; `main`, `source` and `request(operation, args)` are gone.
- `@gramlot/create`
  - The generated `package.json` requires `@gramlot/gramlot` `>=0.2.14`.
- Tests
  - `checkProtocol` (GC-230 §150, 16 items) runs on a fixture page declaring `check_fragment`, `check_endpoint`, `check_endpoint_auth` (`auth: 'admin'`) and `check_endpoint_raise`, without a prefix and with `/app` and a Content Security Policy, on Node and Bun.
  - The serverless tests run the envelope part of the list (items 10, 12-16) over `postMessage`, as GC-230 §205 states.
- Documentation
  - The guides describe the rpc envelope, the outcomes, the Worker messages and the absence of a body size limit.

## Verified

Node.js 23.11 and Bun 1.3.14, with the published core 0.2.14, `@genrojs/builders` 0.4.2 and `@gramlot/gramlot-examples` 0.2.9: the tests of the three packages (server 15 on Node and 15 on Bun, serverless 33, create 3); in Chromium 153 the server checks on Node and Bun, the exported files (hello world, Source live, inline code), the Worker sentinel of the core checkout, the quick start and the page module, the gallery from disk (34 examples), the gallery on Node and Bun under `/js` (33 examples) and the templates of `@gramlot/create`.
